# QYL0110: A catch that throws inside a span starter's scope must call RecordFailure

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.Telemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Error |
| Category | `OpenTelemetry` |
| Code fix | No |
| Analyzer | `Qyl0110MissingRecordFailureAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

A span whose operation fails needs status Error with a description, error.type and the exception event, or the collector records a success with an empty failure message. Call span.RecordFailure(exception) in every catch that throws inside the scope of a Qyl.Spans or Qyl.IncubatingSpans starter.
